resources.title: Star Schema Design Checklist
resources.description: A fillable, step-by-step checklist for Kimball's four-step design process (choose the business process, declare the grain, identify the dimensions, identify the facts), plus a physical-design sanity check for keys, indexing, and partitioning. Filled in underneath using this course's own capstone (Procurement) so you can see exactly what a complete answer to each line looks like before you fill in your own.

resources.title: Dimensional Modeling Glossary
resources.description: Every term from this course's own 'Key terms' tables, compiled chapter by chapter across all eight chapters — OLTP/OLAP, the four fact table types, SCD Types 0-3 and hybrid patterns, staging and ETL vocabulary, junk and bridge and late-arriving dimensions, and physical design terms like columnstore indexing and partition elimination. One reference instead of re-opening 39 lesson guides, and ready-made interview-prep flash material.

resources.title: Build & Populate a Conformed Date Dimension (T-SQL)
resources.description: A real, runnable script that creates dw.DimDate with the YYYYMMDD integer surrogate key this course's capstone uses, inserts the reserved 'unknown' member an accumulating snapshot's unreached milestones point to, and populates 25 years of real calendar rows with a WHILE loop — plus validation queries including the same conformed-dimension check the course's own lab uses against AdventureWorksDW2014. Drop it into any star schema you build in this course; it's written to be reused, not just read.
